WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-05-31')               AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE))   AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-05-31')
          AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
          AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_re_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Real Estate'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Listed Real Estate')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel6 IN ('Portfolio Enhancement DM', 'Portfolio Enhancement EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_re_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

SELECT
    (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)                    AS "Start Date",
    perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id                           AS "BB Unique ID - Current",
    perf_data.security_name                                 AS "Security Name - Current",
    perf_data.bloomberg_code                                AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    perf_data.model_portfolio                               AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_start                         AS "Total Market Value QC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow QC",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_end                           AS "Total Market Value QC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_quotation_currency  AS "Total PnL QC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_start                         AS "Total Market Value PC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow PC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_end                           AS "Total Market Value PC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency - perf_seclvl.period_result_node_by_node_local AS "FX PnL PC",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency  AS "Total PnL PC"
FROM perf_data
INNER JOIN performance.scd_performance_seclvl perf_seclvl
        ON perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_1 = perf_data.model_portfolio
       AND perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_3 = perf_data.bloomberg_code
       AND CAST(perf_seclvl.business_date AS DATE) = DATE('2025-05-31')
ORDER BY perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id,
         perf_data.bloomberg_code

FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		lt.business_date,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel1 as investment_structure_level_01,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2 as investment_structure_level_02,
		uppcc.epm_party_name as ultimate_parent_party_name,

		lt.parent_security_type_name /*as "Exposure Via"*/,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name,
		sum( lt.total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
	from (
		select *
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
		where
			id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
			and id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
				  'MIN1000042'
				, 'NPTESTA'
				, 'NPTESTB'
				, 'PMIEMELTCS'
				, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
				, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
				, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
			) 
			and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough ) -- filter only for the data as of the latest business date
	) lt
	left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite secc
	on
		lt.enterprise_security_id = secc.enterprise_security_id
		and lt.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite pcc
	on
		secc.enterprise_party_id = pcc.enterprise_party_id
		and pcc.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite uppcc
	on
		pcc.ultimate_parent_enterprise_party_id = uppcc.enterprise_party_id
		and uppcc.business_date = pcc.business_date
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
	on
		lt.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	group by
		lt.business_date,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel1,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2,
		uppcc.epm_party_name,
		pcc.epm_party_name,
		lt.parent_security_type_name,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name
), lt_final as (
	select
		  *
		, ultimate_parent_party_name || ' | ' || issuer_name || ' | ' || security_name as combined_entity_name_original
		, ultimate_parent_party_name || ' | ' || issuer_name || ' | ' || security_name_clean as combined_entity_name_clean
		, case
			when investment_structure_level_01 in ( 'Cash for benefits', 'Accounts' ) then '7. Cash for Benefits and Residual Cash'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Total Fund Management' then '1. Total Fund Management'

			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Private Equity' then '5. Private Equity'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Real Assets' then '6. Real Assets'

				when regexp_like( lower( security_type_name ), '.*\b(leg|swap|swaption|option|future|contract|bond|repo|revrepo|buyselback|selbuyback)\b.*' ) then regexp_replace( security_name, '[0-9]', '' )

		from 
			lt_base
	)

        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )

    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,

        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,

-- Query # 13 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code

    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i 
        ON b.business_date = i.business_date

-- Query # 13 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code

-- Query # 13 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,

CAST(e.dv01 AS decimal(22,6)) as dv01,
CAST(f.pv AS decimal(22,6)) as pv

where business_date = '2025-06-05'

and analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' and percent_confidence_level = 95 and run_id in
( select run_id from dag_runs where dag_id = 'active_risk_dag' and business_date = '2025-06-05')
) as var
left join 
(select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, analytic_value as "mean", run_id from
radar_reporting_uat.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_mean 
where business_date = '2025-06-05' and analytic_type = 'MEAN_10YR'
) as b on var.run_id = b.run_id and b.benchmark_name = var.benchmark_name   
and b.hierarchy_type = var.hierarchy_type and b.hierarchy_node = var.hierarchy_node
left join 
(select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, analytic_value as "vol", run_id from
radar_reporting_uat.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_vol

) as c on var.run_id = c.run_id and c.benchmark_name = var.benchmark_name

(
select benchmark_name,  hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, sum(total) as cs01, run_id
from (

radar_reporting_uat.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_cs01
where business_date = '2025-06-05' 
) group by benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, run_id

radar_reporting_uat.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_dv01
where business_date = '2025-06-05'

SELECT firstName, lastName, email, title, divisionId, department, subDepartment
    FROM (SELECT preferred_firstname AS firstName,
            preferred_lastname AS lastName,
            lower(email_address) AS email,
            business_title AS title,
            cost_center_id AS divisionId,
            department,
            sub_department AS subDepartment,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY lower(email_address) ORDER BY hire_date desc) AS rn
        FROM cppib_employee
        WHERE active_status = '1'
        AND LOWER(email_address) NOT LIKE '%test%'
        AND LOWER(email_address) LIKE '%@cppib.com'
        AND preferred_firstname IS NOT NULL
        AND preferred_lastname IS NOT NULL
        AND email_address IS NOT NULL
        AND cost_center_id IS NOT NULL 
        AND department IS NOT NULL
        AND sub_department IS NOT NULL

        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date

            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,

        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,

-- Query # 23 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code
    FROM latest_business_date b
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i 
        ON b.business_date = i.business_date
        AND sec_typ_lvl1_nm != 'Undefined' 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_equity e ON b.business_date = e.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = e.cppib_sec_id 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_warrants w ON b.business_date = w.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = w.cppib_sec_id
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c ON b.business_date = c.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = c.cppib_sec_id

-- Query # 23 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code
    FROM latest_business_date b
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i 
        ON b.business_date = i.business_date
        AND sec_typ_lvl1_nm != 'Undefined' 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_equity e ON b.business_date = e.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = e.cppib_sec_id 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_warrants w ON b.business_date = w.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = w.cppib_sec_id
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c ON b.business_date = c.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = c.cppib_sec_id

-- Query # 23 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,
        COALESCE( e.risk_country_code, w.risk_country_code ) risk_country_code
    FROM latest_business_date b
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers i 
        ON b.business_date = i.business_date
        AND sec_typ_lvl1_nm != 'Undefined' 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_equity e ON b.business_date = e.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = e.cppib_sec_id 
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_warrants w ON b.business_date = w.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = w.cppib_sec_id
    LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c ON b.business_date = c.business_date AND i.cppib_sec_id = c.cppib_sec_id

    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_party_issuer p

/* QuickSight 17f87b09-dae2-47b7-8759-a76155f338de */
SELECT "id_model_portfolio", "InvestmentStructureLevel1", "InvestmentStructureLevel2", "from_date", "to_date", "from_date_total_market_value_pc", "to_date_total_market_value_pc"
FROM (/*
 * IDENTIFY UNMAPPED MPs IN HOLDINGS LOOKTHROUGH
 */	
select
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date
		, max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as to_date
		, case 
			when mhl.business_date = min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion
		and mhl.pool_name not in ( 'ACPP', 'BCPP' )
		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null
	order by 
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
)
group by 
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date) AS "finsights_control_holdings_unmapped_mp"

			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc

WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-01')               AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE))   AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-01')
          AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
          AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_re_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Real Estate'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Listed Real Estate')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel6 IN ('Portfolio Enhancement DM', 'Portfolio Enhancement EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_re_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings_uat.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

SELECT
    (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)                    AS "Start Date",
    perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id                           AS "BB Unique ID - Current",
    perf_data.security_name                                 AS "Security Name - Current",
    perf_data.bloomberg_code                                AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    perf_data.model_portfolio                               AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_start                         AS "Total Market Value QC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow QC",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_end                           AS "Total Market Value QC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_quotation_currency  AS "Total PnL QC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_start                         AS "Total Market Value PC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow PC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_end                           AS "Total Market Value PC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency - perf_seclvl.period_result_node_by_node_local AS "FX PnL PC",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency  AS "Total PnL PC"
FROM perf_data
INNER JOIN performance_uat.scd_performance_seclvl perf_seclvl
        ON perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_1 = perf_data.model_portfolio
       AND perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_3 = perf_data.bloomberg_code
       AND CAST(perf_seclvl.business_date AS DATE) = DATE('2025-06-01')
ORDER BY perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id,
         perf_data.bloomberg_code

SELECT ctev.companyid, companyname, business_description, yearfounded, webpage, ticker,
            country, countrycode, city, region,
            simpleindustryid, simpleindustry,
            pricingdate, TEV, tev_currency,
            cf.period_end_date, capiq_item, value_ltm, kpi_currency,
            investor_id, investor_name, ci.period_end_date as investment_period_end_date,
            percent_of_shares_outstanding as investor_percent_of_shares,
            rank_of_shares_held as investor_rank_of_shares_held
            FROM
            (-- Get company data +TEV
            SELECT companyid, companyname, business_description, yearfounded, webpage, ticker,
                            country, countrycode, city, region,
                            simpleindustryid, simpleindustry,
                            pricingdate, TEV, tev_currency
            FROM
                (SELECT c.companyid, c.companyname, bd.business_description,
                                c.yearfounded, c.webpage,
                                ti.tickersymbol||':'||e.exchange_symbol AS ticker,
                                g.country, g.iso_country_2 AS countrycode, c.city, g.region,
                                c.simpleindustryid,
                                si.simple_industry_description AS simpleindustry,
                                mc.pricingdate,
                                max(pricingdate) over (PARTITION BY c.companyid) AS maxpricingdate,
                                mc.TEV, cur.isocode AS tev_currency
                            FROM capiq_company c
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_business_description bd ON
                                c.companyid = bd.company_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqsimpleindustry si ON
                                c.simpleindustryid = si.simple_industry_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqcountrygeo g ON c.countryid = g.country_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqMarketCap mc ON c.companyid = mc.companyid
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON mc.companyId=s.companyId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_exchange e ON e.exchange_id = ti.exchangeId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqCurrency cur ON ti.currencyId=cur.currencyId
                            WHERE s.primaryFlag=1
                                AND ti.primaryFlag=1
                                AND simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                                AND companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating
                                                                -- 2=Operating Subsidiary
                                AND companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                                AND ((mc.TEV > 0 and cur.isocode is not null) OR mc.TEV IS NULL)
                                AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%8'
                )
            WHERE pricingdate=maxpricingdate
            ) AS ctev
            LEFT JOIN
            (-- Get LTM fundamentals for Public operating companies
            SELECT DISTINCT company_id,
                period_end_date, capiq_item, value_ltm, kpi_currency
            FROM
                (SELECT f.company_id,
                    max(fiscal_chain_id) over (PARTITION BY f.company_id) AS maxfiscalchainid,
                    fiscal_chain_id,
                    max(period_end_date) over (PARTITION BY f.company_id) AS maxperiodenddate,
                    period_end_date,
                    CASE capiq_item_id
                        WHEN 112 THEN 'LTM_Revenue'
                        WHEN 4051 THEN 'LTM_EBITDA'
                    END AS capiq_item,
                    value_ltm, f.currency AS kpi_currency
                FROM cppib_party_fundamental_pit_capiq f
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_company c ON f.company_id = c.companyid
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON f.company_id=s.companyId
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqCurrency cur ON ti.currencyId=cur.currencyId
                WHERE c.simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                    AND c.companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating 2=Operating Subsidiary
                    AND c.companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                    AND s.primaryFlag=1
                    AND ti.primaryFlag=1
                    AND f.pit_date = '2025-06-06'
                    AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%8'
                )
            WHERE period_end_date = maxperiodenddate AND
                fiscal_chain_id = maxfiscalchainid AND
                capiq_item IS NOT NULL
            ) AS cf
            ON ctev.companyid = cf.company_id
            LEFT JOIN
            (select company_id, company_name, investor_id, investor_name, period_end_date,
                    percent_of_shares_outstanding, rank_of_shares_held
            from (select o.company_id, c.companyname as company_name,
                        o.owner_object_id as investor_id,
                        i.companyname as investor_name, o.period_end_date,
                        o.percent_of_shares_outstanding,
                        o.rank_of_shares_held,
                        max(period_end_date) over (partition by o.company_id)
                        as max_period_end_date
                from cppib_party_ownership_pit_capiq o
                    left join capiq_company c on o.company_id = c.companyid
                    left join capiq_company i on o.owner_object_id = i.companyid
                where pit_date_str = '2025-06-06'
                    and o.is_latest_flag = 1
                    AND o.rank_of_shares_held IS NOT NULL
                    AND o.rank_of_shares_held <6
                    AND c.simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                    AND c.companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating 2=Operating Subsidiary
                    AND c.companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                    AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%8'
            )
        where period_end_date = max_period_end_date) AS ci

                            FROM capiq_company c
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_business_description bd ON
                                c.companyid = bd.company_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqsimpleindustry si ON
                                c.simpleindustryid = si.simple_industry_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqcountrygeo g ON c.countryid = g.country_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqMarketCap mc ON c.companyid = mc.companyid
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON mc.companyId=s.companyId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_exchange e ON e.exchange_id = ti.exchangeId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqCurrency cur ON ti.currencyId=cur.currencyId
                            WHERE s.primaryFlag=1
                                AND ti.primaryFlag=1
                                AND simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                                AND companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating
                                                                -- 2=Operating Subsidiary
                                AND companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                                AND ((mc.TEV > 0 and cur.isocode is not null) OR mc.TEV IS NULL)
                                AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%8'
                )
            WHERE pricingdate=maxpricingdate
            ) AS ctev
            LEFT JOIN
            (-- Get LTM fundamentals for Public operating companies
            SELECT DISTINCT company_id,
                period_end_date, capiq_item, value_ltm, kpi_currency
            FROM
                (SELECT f.company_id,
                    max(fiscal_chain_id) over (PARTITION BY f.company_id) AS maxfiscalchainid,
                    fiscal_chain_id,
                    max(period_end_date) over (PARTITION BY f.company_id) AS maxperiodenddate,
                    period_end_date,
                    CASE capiq_item_id
                        WHEN 112 THEN 'LTM_Revenue'
                        WHEN 4051 THEN 'LTM_EBITDA'
                    END AS capiq_item,
                    value_ltm, f.currency AS kpi_currency
                FROM cppib_party_fundamental_pit_capiq f
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_company c ON f.company_id = c.companyid
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON f.company_id=s.companyId
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId
                    LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqCurrency cur ON ti.currencyId=cur.currencyId
                WHERE c.simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                    AND c.companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating 2=Operating Subsidiary
                    AND c.companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                    AND s.primaryFlag=1
                    AND ti.primaryFlag=1
                    AND f.pit_date = '2025-06-06'
                    AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%8'
                )
            WHERE period_end_date = maxperiodenddate AND
                fiscal_chain_id = maxfiscalchainid AND
                capiq_item IS NOT NULL
            ) AS cf
            ON ctev.companyid = cf.company_id
            LEFT JOIN
            (select company_id, company_name, investor_id, investor_name, period_end_date,
                    percent_of_shares_outstanding, rank_of_shares_held
            from (select o.company_id, c.companyname as company_name,
                        o.owner_object_id as investor_id,
                        i.companyname as investor_name, o.period_end_date,
                        o.percent_of_shares_outstanding,
                        o.rank_of_shares_held,
                        max(period_end_date) over (partition by o.company_id)
                        as max_period_end_date
                from cppib_party_ownership_pit_capiq o
                    left join capiq_company c on o.company_id = c.companyid
                    left join capiq_company i on o.owner_object_id = i.companyid
                where pit_date_str = '2025-06-06'
                    and o.is_latest_flag = 1
                    AND o.rank_of_shares_held IS NOT NULL
                    AND o.rank_of_shares_held <6
                    AND c.simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                    AND c.companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating 2=Operating Subsidiary
                    AND c.companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                    AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%8'
            )
        where period_end_date = max_period_end_date) AS ci
            ON ctev.companyid = ci.company_id

		SELECT

			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 06
		AND hour between 12 and 13
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-06 12:18:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 06
		AND hour between 14 and 15
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-06 14:56:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 06
		AND hour between 16 and 17
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-06 16:23:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

with cppibsecid_match as (
      select distinct
        hold.abor_security_number AS SCD_abor_sec_no,
        hold.business_date as businessdate,
        'query_1' as subquery_nme,
        regexp_replace(hold.abor_security_number, '(?i)^cpp', '') as id_holdingdecomposition,
        val.instrument_id_type as holdingdecompositionidtypecode,
        hold.abor_security_id as instrumentalternateid,
        hold.abor_security_name as instrumentname,
        hold.abor_instrument_type as instrumentgroupname,
        class.cppib_sector_classification_name_1 as industrysectorname,
        class.cppib_sector_classification_name_2 as industrygroupname,
        class.cppib_country_of_exposure_code as countryofexposurecode,
        gics1.name as gicssectorname,

        hold.abor_security_type_id AS instrumenttypecode,

        party.parent_cppib_party_id as id_issuerparentparty,
        party.ultimate_parent_cppib_party_id as id_issuerultimateparentparty
      from holdings.enterprise_holding hold 
        --   JOIN max_date md ON CAST(hold.business_date AS DATE) = CAST(md.business_date AS DATE)
              INNER JOIN asset.enterprise_security sec 
                ON  sec.business_date  = hold.business_date and cast (hold.cppib_sec_id as integer) = sec.cppib_sec_id
              LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications class
                ON sec.cppib_sec_id = class.cppib_sec_id 
                and sec.business_date = class.business_date
              LEFT JOIN party.enterprise_party party
                ON sec.cppib_party_id = party.cppib_party_id
                AND cast(hold.business_date as date) = party.business_date
       left join holdings.holding_valuation val 
     on val.id_instrument = regexp_replace(hold.abor_security_number, '(?i)^cpp', '')
     and val.business_date = cast(hold.business_date as date)
      left join party.party_gics_classifications gics1
        on CAST(sec.cppib_party_id AS INTEGER) = gics1.cppib_party_id and hold.business_date = gics1.business_date and gics1.level = 1
      left join party.party_gics_classifications gics2
        on CAST(sec.cppib_party_id AS INTEGER) = gics2.cppib_party_id and hold.business_date = gics2.business_date and gics2.level = 2

        on CAST(sec.cppib_party_id AS INTEGER) = gics3.cppib_party_id and hold.business_date = gics3.business_date and gics3.level = 3
      left join party.party_gics_classifications gics4

        hold.abor_security_type_id AS instrumenttypecode,

              left join asset.enterprise_security sec 
                on  sec.business_date  = hold.business_date and cast (hold.cppib_sec_id as integer) = sec.cppib_sec_id
              inner join latest_date ld 
                on ld.cppib_sec_id = cast(hold.cppib_sec_id as integer)
              inner join asset.asset_security_identifiers iden 
                on iden.cppib_sec_id = ld.cppib_sec_id

              inner join asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications class

              left join party.party_gics_classifications gics1

                and gics1.level = 1

                and cast(hold.business_date as date) = gics2.business_date
                and gics2.level = 2

              left join party.enterprise_party party

SELECT "id_model_portfolio", "InvestmentStructureLevel1", "InvestmentStructureLevel2", "from_date", "to_date", "from_date_total_market_value_pc", "to_date_total_market_value_pc"
FROM (/*
 * IDENTIFY UNMAPPED MPs IN HOLDINGS LOOKTHROUGH
 */	
select
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date
		, max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as to_date
		, case 
			when mhl.business_date = min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion
		and mhl.pool_name not in ( 'ACPP', 'BCPP' )
		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null
	order by 
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
)
group by 
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date) AS "finsights_control_holdings_unmapped_mp"

        st.additional_payable_amount_quotation_currency,
        st.ibor_reason,
        st.dividend_per_share,
        st.borrowing_account,
        st.rn,
        -- From joins (aliased where needed)
        es.sedol,
        es.isin,
        es.cusip,
        es.esm_incorp_country_code,
        es.security_name_id,
        es.esm_country_code,
        es.cppib_country_of_exposure_name,
        es.cppib_currency_of_exposure_name,
        smp.sst_custody_account_code,
        smp.model_portfolio_name,
        smp.investment_strategy_name,
        smp.investment_department_name,
        ep.party_id,
        ep.epm_party_name,
        ss.abor_security_group_name AS ss_abor_security_group_name,
        ss.abor_security_type_name AS ss_abor_security_type_name,
        ss.abor_instrument_type_id,
        ss.investment_type_name,
        ss.abor_coupon_rate,
        rec.country_ref_code,
        rcc_exchange_country.country_name AS esm_country_name,
        rcc_incorp_country.country_name AS esm_incorp_country_name,
        sp.portfolio_group_id,
        sp.portfolio_name,
        sp.portfolio_group_name,
        rcc_trade_country.country_name AS country_ref_name,
        rcc.currency_name AS quotation_currency_name,
        stc.abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
        stc.other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
        stc.abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
        stc.other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
        stc.coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
        stc.coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
        stc.coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
        stc.restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
        stc.restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
        stc.restitution_expected_settlement_currency,
        shm.accrued_interest_portfolio_currency AS shm_accrued_interest_portfolio_currency,
        shm.accrued_interest_quotation_currency AS shm_accrued_interest_quotation_currency,
        spif.investmentstructurelevel3,
        spif.investmentstructurelevel4
    FROM RankedTransactions st
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM asset.enterprise_security
    ) es ON st.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id AND es.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio smp 
        ON smp.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio)
        AND st.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scd_party_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM party.enterprise_party
    ) ep ON st.counterparty_id = ep.scd_party_id AND ep.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_securities ss 
        ON st.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
        AND ss.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_securities)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_exchange_codes rec 
        ON es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
        AND rec.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_exchange_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country 
        ON es.esm_country_code = rcc_exchange_country.country_code
        AND rcc_exchange_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country 
        ON es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
        AND rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY portfolio_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS latest
        FROM reference.scd_portfolio
    ) sp ON sp.latest = 1 AND sp.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country 
        ON rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
        AND rcc_trade_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            abor_transaction_number,
            business_date,
            transaction_cancellation_flag,
            trade_date,
            abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
            amount_quotation_currency AS other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
            abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
            amount_portfolio_currency AS other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_settlement_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_settlement_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_settlement_currency,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY abor_transaction_number
                ORDER BY business_date DESC
            ) AS latest
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transaction_cost
        WHERE transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
    ) stc
    ON stc.latest = 1
       AND st.abor_transaction_number = stc.abor_transaction_number
       AND st.transaction_cancellation_flag = stc.transaction_cancellation_flag
       AND st.trade_date = stc.trade_date
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id, portfolio_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main
    ) shm ON shm.abor_security_id = st.abor_security_id
        AND shm.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
        AND shm.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes rcc 
        ON st.quotation_currency = rcc.currency_code
        AND rcc.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_currency_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY model_portfolio ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
    ) spif
        ON spif.model_portfolio = st.model_portfolio_id
        AND spif.rn = 1
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
               ORDER BY business_date DESC
           ) AS final_rank
    FROM JoinedData
    WHERE rn = 1
) deduped
WHERE final_rank = 1) AS "transactions_base"
LIMIT 1000

/* QuickSight */
SELECT ds.* FROM ( SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Real Assets~CORE' THEN 'Real Assets'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Real Estate~CORE' THEN 'Real Estate'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Infrastructure (P)~CORE' THEN 'Infrastructure'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Sustainable Energy Group~CORE' THEN 'Sustainable Energy Group'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Credit Investments~CORE' THEN 'Credit Investments'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Antares (P)~CORE' THEN 'Antares'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Active Credit ex. Antares~CORE' THEN 'Active Credit ex. Antares'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Private Equity~CORE' THEN 'Private Equity'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Funds & Secondaries~CORE' THEN 'Funds & Secondaries'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Direct Private Equity (S)~CORE' THEN 'Direct Private Equity'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Private Equity Asia~CORE' THEN 'Private Equity Asia'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Growth Equity (P)~CORE' THEN 'Growth Equity'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Listed Real Estate~CORE' THEN 'Listed Real Estate'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy PE Asia~CORE' THEN 'ISG PE Asia'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy Growth Equity~CORE' THEN 'ISG PE GE'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy DEILA~CORE' THEN 'ISG AE DEILA'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy FIG~CORE' THEN 'ISG PE FIG'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy Funds & Secondaries~CORE' THEN 'ISG PE F&S'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy SEG~CORE' THEN 'ISG RA SEG'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy AE Asia~CORE' THEN 'ISG AE Asia'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy Direct Private Equity~CORE' THEN 'ISG PE DPE'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy RE~CORE' THEN 'ISG RA RE'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy~CORE' THEN 'ISG Legacy'
        ELSE a.hierarchy_node
    END AS hierarchy_node,
    
    CAST(a.business_date AS DATE) AS business_date,

    -- Fiscal Quarter Tagging
    CASE
        WHEN a.business_date IN (
            SELECT MAX(business_date)
            FROM risk_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_vol
            WHERE month(date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (3,6,9,12)
              AND date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') < date_trunc('month', current_date)
            GROUP BY year(date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')), month(date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d'))
        )
        THEN CASE
            WHEN month(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (4,5,6)
                THEN 'F' || substr(cast(year(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 AS varchar), 3, 2) || ' Q1'
            WHEN month(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (7,8,9)
                THEN 'F' || substr(cast(year(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 AS varchar), 3, 2) || ' Q2'
            WHEN month(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (10,11,12)
                THEN 'F' || substr(cast(year(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 AS varchar), 3, 2) || ' Q3'
            ELSE 'F' || substr(cast(year(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) AS varchar), 3, 2) || ' Q4'
        END
        ELSE NULL
    END AS fiscal_quarter,

    a.analytic_value AS active_vol_10yr,  
    b.pv, 
    CASE 
        WHEN b.pv IS NOT NULL AND b.pv != 0 THEN a.analytic_value / b.pv 
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS active_vol_number,
    
    TRY_CAST(beta.analytic_value AS DOUBLE) AS TenYr_Beta

FROM risk_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_vol a

LEFT JOIN risk_prod.benchmark_analytic_pv b
    ON a.hierarchy_node = b.node_name
    AND CAST(b.business_date AS DATE) = CAST(a.business_date AS DATE)

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        c.business_date, 
        c.analytic_value, 
        d.node_name
    FROM risk_prod.fact_analytic_md_rel_var c
    LEFT JOIN risk_prod.dim_hierarchy_node d
        ON d.dim_hierarchy_node_id = c.dim_hierarchy_node_id_1
        AND d.business_date = c.business_date
    WHERE c.portfolio_type_2 = 'SAP CORE'
      AND c.analytic_name = '10 Year Beta'
) beta
    ON a.hierarchy_node = beta.node_name
    AND CAST(beta.business_date AS DATE) = CAST(a.business_date AS DATE)

WHERE a.benchmark_name = 'SAP CORE'
  AND a.analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR'
  AND a.hierarchy_node IN (
      'Real Assets~CORE', 'Real Estate~CORE', 'Infrastructure (P)~CORE', 
      'Sustainable Energy Group~CORE', 'Credit Investments~CORE', 
      'Antares (P)~CORE', 'Active Credit ex. Antares~CORE', 
      'Private Equity~CORE', 'Funds & Secondaries~CORE', 
      'Direct Private Equity (S)~CORE', 'Private Equity Asia~CORE', 
      'Growth Equity (P)~CORE', 'Listed Real Estate~CORE', 'ISG Legacy PE Asia~CORE',
      'ISG Legacy Growth Equity~CORE','ISG Legacy DEILA~CORE','ISG Legacy FIG~CORE',
      'ISG Legacy Funds & Secondaries~CORE','ISG Legacy SEG~CORE','ISG Legacy AE Asia~CORE',
      'ISG Legacy Direct Private Equity~CORE','ISG Legacy~CORE','ISG Legacy RE~CORE'
  )
  AND CAST(a.business_date AS DATE) > DATE '2025-03-30' ) ds LIMIT 0

WITH latest_transactions AS (

SELECT

FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions tr
) t
WHERE rn = 1
),
latest_securities AS (
SELECT *
FROM (
SELECT
s.*,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CAST(abor_security_number AS VARCHAR) ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
FROM reference.scd_securities s
) s
WHERE rn = 1
),
latest_security_identifiers AS (

),

    FROM asset.enterprise_security

    st.interest_dividend_capital_event_quotation_currency,
    st.interest_dividend_capital_event_portfolio_currency,
    st.transaction_cancellation_flag,
    st.reconciliation_status,
    st.created_date,
    ep.party_id,
    ep.epm_party_name,
    st.transaction_number_in_originating_system,
    st.payment_amount_quotation_currency,
    st.payment_amount_portfolio_currency,
    st.external_short_tag,
    st.settlement_date,
    st.quotation_currency,
    st.number_of_units,
    CASE 
        WHEN ss.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') AND st.abor_security_name LIKE '%CAD%' THEN 'Y'
        WHEN ss.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') THEN 'N'
    END AS cross_deal_indicator,
    st.settlement_location,
    es.esm_country_code,
    rec.country_ref_code,
    rcc_exchange_country.country_name AS esm_country_name,
    rcc_incorp_country.country_name AS esm_incorp_country_name,
    sp.portfolio_group_id,
    ss.abor_security_group_name,
    ss.abor_security_type_name,
    smp.model_portfolio_name,
    rcc_trade_country.country_name AS country_ref_name,
    rcc.currency_name AS quotation_currency_name,
    st.price AS price_qc,
    st.price * st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS price_pc,
    st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency,
    es.cppib_country_of_exposure_name,
    es.cppib_currency_of_exposure_name,
    sp.portfolio_name,
    sp.portfolio_group_name,
    smp.investment_strategy_name,
    smp.investment_department_name,
    ss.abor_instrument_type_id,
    ss.investment_type_name,
    stc.abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
    stc.other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
    stc.abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
    stc.other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
    st.portfolio_id,
    st.ibor_reason,
    ss.abor_coupon_rate,
    st.dividend_per_share,
    st.borrowing_account,
    stc.coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
    stc.coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
    stc.coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
    stc.restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
    stc.restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
    stc.restitution_expected_settlement_currency,
    st.accrued_interest_portfolio_currency,
    st.accrued_interest_quotation_currency,
    st.current_value_portfolio_currency,
    st.current_value_quotation_currency,
    st.additional_payable_amount_portfolio_currency,
    st.additional_payable_amount_quotation_currency,
    spif.investmentstructurelevel3,
    spif.investmentstructurelevel4
FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions st
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM asset.enterprise_security
) es ON st.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id AND es.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio smp 
    ON smp.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio)
    AND st.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scd_party_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM party.enterprise_party
) ep ON st.counterparty_id = ep.scd_party_id AND ep.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN reference.scd_securities ss 
    ON st.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
    AND ss.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_securities)
LEFT JOIN reference.reference_exchange_codes rec 
    ON es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
    AND rec.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_exchange_codes)
LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country 
    ON es.esm_country_code = rcc_exchange_country.country_code
    AND rcc_exchange_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country 
    ON es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
    AND rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY portfolio_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS latest
    FROM reference.scd_portfolio
) sp ON sp.latest = 1 AND sp.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country 
    ON rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
    AND rcc_trade_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        abor_transaction_number,
        business_date,
        transaction_cancellation_flag,
        trade_date,
        abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
        amount_quotation_currency AS other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
        abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
        amount_portfolio_currency AS other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
        (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
        (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
        (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_settlement_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
        (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
        (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
        (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_settlement_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_settlement_currency,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY abor_transaction_number
            ORDER BY business_date DESC
        ) AS latest
    FROM trades_deals.scd_transaction_cost
    WHERE transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
) stc
ON stc.latest = 1
   AND st.abor_transaction_number = stc.abor_transaction_number
   AND st.transaction_cancellation_flag = stc.transaction_cancellation_flag
   AND st.trade_date = stc.trade_date
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id, portfolio_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main
) shm ON shm.abor_security_id = st.abor_security_id
    AND shm.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
    AND shm.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes rcc 
    ON st.quotation_currency = rcc.currency_code
    AND rcc.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_currency_codes)
LEFT JOIN performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten spif
    ON spif.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten)
    AND st.model_portfolio_id = spif.model_portfolio
    AND spif.investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24' ) ds LIMIT 0

WITH

        SELECT
            DATE('2025-05-29')               AS input_date,

        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-05-29')
          AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL

    ),

    listed_re_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (

                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Listed Real Estate')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel6 IN ('Portfolio Enhancement DM', 'Portfolio Enhancement EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')

            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency

            MAX(

                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency

                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 06
		AND hour between 09 and 10
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-06 09:06:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 06
		AND hour between 17 and 18
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-06 17:53:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000
